families.name: Bilateral bodyweight squat
families.definition: Synthetic classification template for bilateral aligned-stance bodyweight squatting without hand-held load or external hand support. Demonstrates independent stance and grip applicability; not an exercise catalog entry. Stance geometry refers to the upright standing setup immediately before descent; foot placement is maintained during the repetition.

families.name: Bilateral side-held dumbbell squat
families.definition: Synthetic classification template for bilateral aligned-stance squatting with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides and fixed neutral forearms. Demonstrates that lower-body movements may also require grip; not an exercise catalog entry. Stance geometry refers to the upright standing setup immediately before descent; foot placement is maintained during the repetition.
